content:
The framework of Christianity that we have seen so far about getting closer to God, many feel it's about a constant unending approach to God. But in Christ, God has brought us to rest, into the fullness of how He is, this is Perfection that we know Him as He is. Christ is the arrival, the totality of Oneness! 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

It is clear to see that Jesus did not die for Himself, He died for us all, but many have not come to the reality that He also didn't rise for Himself, we are raised together with Him into Perfection. This is God's desire for us, to experience the fullness of the resurrection. Just are we have accepted His death, we must now walk in the glory of His ressurrection!
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Any area that you still feel will only work by your own effort and might is an area that you have not yet surrendered to the Resurrection power of Jesus Christ. The price Jesus paid in His death is so much more than what mankind has come to understand. His Resurrection brings all things into Perfection.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Just like Grace broke the dividing wall between Jews and Gentiles making one new man; Perfection has broken the divide between the physical and the spiritual, it is no longer to different realms. Jesus at His ressurrection was both physical and spiritual to the point that He acsended into Heaven even with the clothes He was wearing, that is how real the onesness has become. This is the Resurrected Life.   
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Heaven is not supposed to be seen as a destination but rather a place from which we function and manifest. We are called to bring it's manifestation all around us. The reality of Heaven is round about you and finds its expression through your everyday life. This is the doing of the Lord, perfecting everything around you!
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

In the age we have just left we understood and rejoiced in the fact that Jesus never fails, but that's not the reality of Perfection, in Perfection Jesus is not trying to do anything for you, He has brought you into Perfect rest, into the fulfillment of all things, you are not asking for anything, but have come into the resurrection experience. This is Perfection. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Truth is truth no matter who accepts it, ones ability to comprehend something does not make it truth. The Earth was spherical even if men believed it was flat for a thousand years. God through Christ has brought Perfection into being, we are now called to manifest it, it is already here.  
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Creation is not waiting for people who are similar to Jesus, or Christ-like in their thoughts and action's, it is earnestly waiting for the Manifestation of the Son's of God, these are those who are completely conformed into the image and nature of the risen Christ! This is Perfection, it cannot work any other way. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus came to Perfect Creation, this is the Father's desire, it is more than just helping people out of their troubles and affliction, the Lord desires to bring mankind into the fullness of His blessing, this is beyond receiving breakthrough, it's a state of Perfection in Christ, being brought into His very Nature.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

It is not in God's nature to do a temporal work, or a mere quick fix. Jesus came to bring all things unto Perfection, that is what the Totality of the Resurrection is, He left nothing else to be done, all was accomplished and completed, don't accept anything less, that which is PERFECT is Come.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus came to give life to the Full, a life that doesn't fluctuate or change, it is a life of permanent fullness. This is the Perfection that is granted to us in Christ Jesus. The Holy Spirit leads us into this reality, as the Father has willed it! Perfection!
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

God makes everything PERFECT, and you are His child, how could you be everything less, this is more than a confession, it is by the working of God's power that He wrought when He raised Christ from the dead. He manifested Perfection to all creation. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Ressurrection is the foundation upon which the whole Christian faith stands, without which Apostle Paul write that we of all men are most pitiable. But one thing that we need to realise is that the Ressurrection is not just the basis of our walk with God, it is the image into which we are being conformed, it is the reality of the life God has made available for us in Christ Jesus; Perfection!
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The things you pray to keep are usually the things that you ought to lose in order to manifest and experience Perfection. Anything that can be lost is that which is not Perfect, the Ressurrection Life in Christ can't be lost or changed. It is a life that is affected by nothing, yet affects everything around it. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is not just the first, highest or the best, He fills all in all, all things are in Him, there is nothing outside Him, this is His Lordship and reign, He is existence and the fullness of it. He fills and perfects all things! 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Don't get lost in the search for satisfaction outside the reality of Christ! The world and all it has to offer was not designed to bring fulfillment or satisfaction. Christ is the Perfect desire of the Creation, in Him all things are brought to rest and fulfilment! 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

What Jesus wants to manifest in you is His Fullness, to live life less than that is a misrepresentation of God's desire for your life. Perfection does not come by our effort or strength, it is the working of the Ressurrection power on a man's life that completely conforms him into the image of the risen Christ! 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

At the core of the Father sending His Son to die for us is the Perfection of all things, He did not just die for man to have a right standing with Him, the death to Christ is the access for all things to come into the resurrection experience, therein is the finished work of Christ, salvation and rightousness are means to an end; Perfection.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

There are a lot of Manifestations of God that are done through angelic agency. There are angels that are sent forth to minister whenever God is called upon for things like, Protection, Healing, Provision, Strength etc, but when it comes to Perfection it is not the work of angels, God Himself is one who Perfects all things, it is the working of the Godhead in Manifestation.  
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Joy and Pleasure of a father is seeing His Son's be like Him, this is the joy of God the Father, He is pleased with Jesus being His express image and the brightness of His person. He has no less expectations from us. Through the power of the resurrection of Jesus Christ, God made this experience possible, we are called to manifest Him in Full. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

There is no sacrifice bigger or more powerful than that of the Lamb of God. If you feel undeserving of something because you haven't earned the right to it, look to the Perfect sacrifice, look at what God the Father did in Christ, therein lies your access and right to all things! The Power of the Cross has not yet been fathomed to it's perfect depth, there is more.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Christ is all in all, He is the fullness of all things, He is not just a person, when the Father raised Jesus from the dead, He brought all things into Him, Christ is the head if all creation. Jesus is the Resurrection, He is a place, He is a Time, He is a Person, He is an Action, He is the fullness of the Godhead bodily. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not a message or revelation, it is not even a doctrine, it is the experience of being brought into the reality of the Resurrection. It is coming into the fullness of How He is. Perfection is a state, it is the Manifestation of Christ as He is.  
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

God the Father is passionate about brings all creation unto Perfection, by the Manifestation of the Son's of God. The drive of the Holy Spirit in us is not just to equip us with His Power or to make us good Christians, He is at work in us to bring about the Manifestation of Christ, till we are fully conformed into His Image. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Don't be ruled by time, you are in Christ, all Creation is bound to the power and Government of Time, in Christ we are freed from time and its effects, this is the Power of His Ressurrection, Jesus Christ is the ruler of Time and the head of it. You are called into the one who is Alpha and Omega. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

God gave His son to bring us into His fullness, we are called to manifest Christ as He is, this is God's Original intent for the Church. The resurrection brought about Perfect oneness with God in Christ. This is our highest call.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

God gave full authority and responsibility of the Earth to man, this is why for Him to successfully bring mankind to Salvation He had to become a Man. In order for Perfection to be established to all creation God through the Holy Spirit has brought men into the Resurrection, and through us Perfection is Manifested to all Creation. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The voice of God shatters fears and impossibility, the word of God is the shape of possibility and existence, all things are held together and framed by the Word! Perfection is a reality because it is manifest in the revealing of the Risen Christ! Immortality is a reality because the Word of God frames it for us. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Donit use your experiences to judge Perfection, Christ is Perfection, He is it's reality, build your truth on How He is not how you as, For as He is so are we. Jesus is Truth, He is Reality, Perfection is reality. We are called to manifest Christ as He is; Perfection! 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Love is truth, Love is reality, Love is how God is, God doesn't have Love, He IS Love. Love is not expressed Love is an Expression, it is the Manifestation of Truth, the Revelation of Perfection to all Creation! This is God's Original Intent, Love Experienced by all Creation.  
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Greatest joy of a father is to see his son's reach the fullness of who they were meant to be. God the Father has called us to the reality of the Ressurected Christ, let us never settle for less, Perfection is our call and purpose.   
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

He is the God of Perfect Justice, Jesus does not take sides, He comes to take charge, He doesn't side with anyone, He brings His reality in every situation and reveals the truth that He is the right judgment in all circumstances. He is Perfect Justice! The Father has committed all Judgement to the son.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The hope of Creation, is not in better government laws or in the rise of a correct political regime, in fact it is not even in popular religion. The liberation of Creation is the Manifestation of the Ressurected Christ, this are the coming of the Perfected Sons of God; we are the hope of Creation. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

There is no sacrifice that anyone can give that can earn them access to Perfection, for there is only one Perfect Sacrifice, the death of Jesus Christ. If one cannot see Perfection in His death, they will not be able to experience it in their life. The Resurrection is the result of the perfect sacrifice, to know the glory of the ressurrection one must know the depth of His death. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

It has been said that God will turn your life around, but it has not been defined to what He would turn it to, the obvious answer would be that He will make bad things good, this definition however leaves out the rich and powerful from their need for God. We must understand that God's standard is Perfection, He brings all things into the state of Christ.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

What you know about Christ will be your reality. God does not change, He is the same as He has always been, but our knowledge of Him is changeable and will casue us to have radically different experiences in our lives. Jesus is reality, what you know Him will be your reality of everything. He is Perfection. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The end of the year for most is a chance to push the reset button, do so if you have to ,start afresh, get you resolutions in order, purse big dreams and set your ambitions high. But don't just let 2021 just be another otherwise 365 days from now you'll be pressing that button again, there is a perfect life in Christ, unchanged by time or seasons, forever established and real, exit the time cycle trap, that which is PERFECT is Come! 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

As we start out this year, one must be sure of their convictions, they will be your guide as you try to navigate through life. Jesus gave us the Holy Spirit to enable us to know who we are and where we are going. Perfection is a reality for those who can see Him as He is, and this truth affects everything around us. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

God's best for you is to manifest Christ as He is, this is the fullness of existence, God has preordained us to be comformed to the image of His Son, but not only us, all Creation finds its true purpose and meaning in the reality of how He is. God desire is to bring all things into PERFECTION! 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

There is no time in History that can be used to describe or exemplify what is beginning to manifest in the Earth! That which is Perfect is come, The Kingdom is here, this is an experience that will change the very fabric of existence. Many are looking at the world from the lense of fear, but the Lord is a doing bring all things into their original purpose; Perfection! 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Are you fulfilling purpose? What did the Father send you here on Earth to do? You will never be fulfilled living outside purpose, no matter how much money you make, no matter how much influence you may have, the Lord has called us to manifest His call and Purpose for your life. There is an original purpose, Perfection is Come!
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is a real, it is not a theory or an idea, it is not even a doctrine, Perfection is the pulsating life of the risen Christ, it is the manifestation of His reality in all things, this what Creation is groaning for. That which is PERFECT is come! 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Christ in Perfection is not taking us to any destination, we are not about to walk into anything new or Greater, Perfection is a state of being, it is the reality of Christ as He is, there is nothing higher. He is the fullness of Everything!  
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

I am as He is, Jesus is my Life. This is beyond a religious claim, this is an experience of Truth. We stand at a place where we are no longer dealing with ideas and doctrines, rather we are manifesting the reality of Christ as He is. That which is PERFECT is come.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

God honors Rest, most people don't know or understand the true of meaning of Rest, it is not relaxation; Jesus is Rest, He is the completion of the work of the Father, Rest is the Manifestation of Perfection, it only occurs when all things are brought into the state of the finished work of Christ. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

When you count the cost of Perfection you'll find that there is nothing that can be paid to earn it, no sacrifice is big enough, this is because it is not manifested in the realm of sowing and reaping, there is no process that can bring it about. Perfection is the state of Christ as He is and His manifest in all Creation. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is the Lord of all things, you cannot place anything outside Him. If there is one thing that one may percieve as not being in Him, their revelation and perception of Christ is wrong. He is the Perfection in all creation, He is the original purpose and design of existence. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection doesn't coming by hearing about it, we are brought into Perfection by beholding Jesus as He is, the question is can you see Him in the reality of His ressurrection? Herein lies the truth of Perfection, it is a seen experience that pull us into Himself. Behold the Risen Christ
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is beyond legal rights and legislation, Perfection is manifested by the Power of an endlessly life that pulls all things into the reality of the Resurrection. The Resurrection of Christ was not based on any legal premiss it was the working of God's mighty Power, that brought about a state of existence that has never been, that is not subject to any laws or principle's. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

For so long now men have prayed and ask God for what they desire, for solution's to problems and fulfilment of needs, but the Lord is bring about the fullness of His purpose. In Perfection it's not about any of our personal desires or needs, it is the manifestation of the Father's inheritance in us, it's His original purpose. The Kingdom is here. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*
